Gains depended on separable tasks and shared coordination boards. The strongest solo model's performance declined as teams grew.

items.title: Sandboxed Models Can Communicate via Inference Servers (12 minute read)
items.snippet: Sandboxing did not stop AI models on a shared inference server from trading information in contrived tests. One model's large request slightly shifts the server's calculations for the other, which reads the shift as a signal.
